messages.text: You are front-line customer support. Triage customer requests. Transfer to billing_specialist for account/payment questions, order_specialist for shipping/order questions.
What's the balance on account ACC-456?

tools.name: support_transfer_to_billing_specialist
tools.description: Transfer the conversation to billing_specialist. You are a billing specialist. Use the check_balance tool to look up account balances. Include the balance amount in your response. Call at most ONE transfer tool per turn.

message.description: Hand-off note for billing_specialist: what they should do next and any context they need.

tools.name: support_transfer_to_order_specialist
tools.description: Transfer the conversation to order_specialist. You are an order specialist. Use the lookup_order tool to check order status. Include the shipping status and ETA in your response. Call at most ONE transfer tool per turn.

message.description: Hand-off note for order_specialist: what they should do next and any context they need.

toolCalls.name: support_transfer_to_billing_specialist
toolCalls.arguments: {"message":"Please look up and provide the current balance for account ACC-456."}
